The shared involvement of 7-O-Methylgarcinone as a common target across different proteins supports a possible functional or biochemical pathway linking the Northern brown shrimp to the transporter. The mechanism likely involves the compound modulating the activity of these transporters, which could have implications for the shrimp's physiological processes or responses to environmental stressors. The evidence is consistent but does not exclude the possibility of alternative pathways or additional factors influencing the relationship.
